title: Modeling Subjectivity in Cognitive Appraisal with Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models with explicit demographic personas (including age, gender, ethnicity, and education) to evaluate their ability to capture human-like subjectivity and variance in cognitive appraisal ratings.

Comparing the variance and distribution of cognitive appraisal ratings across different participant geographic regions (e.g., Europe, Americas, Asia, Africa, Oceania) to assess how well models capture region-specific subjective interpretations.

Injecting Big-Five personality trait profiles into language model prompts to measure how specific personality characteristics influence the distribution and variance of predicted cognitive appraisal ratings compared to human annotations.
